## NSXL for Windows 1.3.0

A polish update.

- **Settings are easier to read.** Each setting's description now sits under its name instead of squeezed beside it.
- **Mouse hover.** Tiles, menus, settings rows, tabs and buttons react when you point at them.
- **Notifications** now drop in at the top of the screen, clear of the dock and button hints.
- **Bigger tiles in All Software**, so names fit.
- **Play time cards** no longer cut off (for example "3h 20m").
- **News** shows its loading status under the tabs instead of over them.
- Smoother text and steady-width numbers on the clock and stats.
- NSXL follows Windows' *Animation effects* setting.

Download **NSXL-Setup** to install, or **NSXL-Portable** to run without installing.
